snippet.title: Arcane Eats - Official Expanded Demo Launch Trailer | Women-Led Games x SGF 2026
snippet.description: Watch the Expanded Demo Launch Trailer for Arcane Eats, a fantasy roguelike deckbuilding game developed by Wonderbelly Games. Players will recruit a crew to man the stoves and lead a kitchen crew of legends. Balance resources, rise through the cooking guilds, and become a master chef before The Hunger consumes all. Arcane Eats is coming soon to PC (Steam), with an expanded demo available now on Steam.
